thread:
incidents-bot: Pager alert — CRITICAL: canary error-rate spike detected for model route /v1/generate (model: gpt-q-3.1-canary). 5m error rate 22% (>5% threshold). Links: https://alerts.redwood.internal/ALERT-4721

devon (oncall): I'm on it. Acknowledging page. Will triage canary traffic first.

jordan (sre): Taking lead for infra. devon, can you paste a sample request_id from failing calls and any stack traces? I'll pull network and node metrics.

maria (ml-oncall): I saw a drop in token throughput on the canary pods earlier. Could be a model binary mismatch or quantization fallback.

devon (oncall): Sample request IDs: req_20260315_aaa1, req_20260315_aaa8. Error snippet from app logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:22:03Z ERROR handler: generation failed req=req_20260315_aaa1 err="kv-cache lookup failed: incompatible-kv-format"
stack: inference/runtime/cache.go:112 -> inference/serve/handler.go:78
```

sam (engineer): Sharing canary pod stderr dump (truncated):
```
[kernel] quantized model load: backend=triton fallback=false
panic: unsupported tensor layout: int4_blocked
goroutine 34 [running]:
main.loadModel(0x7f...)\n\t/mount/runtime/loader/loader.go:213 +0x1b2
```

lee (infra): Observability graphs: canary pod CPU spiked 3x at 18:21, queue length increased. Prod pods steady. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/canary-vs-prod

jordan (sre): Timeline so far (working):
- 18:15 - canary rollout started (automated canary job v2026-03-15-1020)
- 18:19 - first errors appear, alert threshold crossed at 18:22
- 18:25 - page to oncall

carla (product): Any customer-facing impact yet? Which customers are on this canary? We should assess before rollback if any external traffic routed.

devon (oncall): Only internal-traffic flag was supposed to route to canary. Checking routing table... `redwoodctl route list --filter=canary=true` returns 12 internal test orgs and 0 prod orgs. So customer impact = low, but internal integration tests failing.

maria (ml-oncall): Hypothesis candidates (threaded):
1) Model build with new quantization kernel shipped in v2026-03-15-1020 incompatible with runtime (unsupported int4 layout). Evidence: panic message mentions `int4_blocked`.
2) Runtime kernel selector picked a new triton kernel due to CPU/GPU change; config mismatch.
3) Routing accidentally pointed to incompatible runtime variant (docker image tag mismatch).

sam (engineer): I diffed the canary image vs known-good image from last week:
```
# redwoodctl image inspect gpt-q-3.1-canary:v2026-03-15-1020
build_hash: b7c9d2a
quant_profile: qint4-blocked

# baseline v2026-03-12-0876
build_hash: 3a1f8c9
quant_profile: qint4-packed
```
Difference: quantization profile changed to `qint4-blocked` in the canary build.

devon (oncall): Running quick check: `redwoodctl model verify --model gpt-q-3.1-canary --assert quant_profile=qint4-packed` -> failed. Looks like the build bump included a new quant profile.

lee (infra): Also confirmed image tag on canary pods is `gpt-q-3.1-canary:v2026-03-15-1020` while routing config expected `...:v2026-03-12-0876` due to rollout job pulling latest tag. So rollout pipeline changed tag resolution.

jordan (sre): Risk assessment: internal-only route, but failing in CI and e2e. If we let canary continue, increased noise and potential for customers if routing rules change. Recommendation: roll back canary to last-known-good build v2026-03-12-0876.

carla (product): +1 for rollback. We'll pause the rest of the rollout and notify integrations team.

maria (ml-oncall): Agreed. Root cause likely a new quantization profile incompatible with current runtime build; needs coordinated runtime kernel support or model re-quantization.

devon (oncall): Rolling back now. Command:
```
# rollback canary
redwoodctl rollout set --route canary --image gpt-q-3.1-canary:v2026-03-12-0876 --wait
```

observability-bot: Deploy triggered: rollout-id=rl-20260315-998; target image=v2026-03-12-0876; started at 18:34

lee (infra): Watching pods come up. Health checks green at 18:36. Canary error rate back to baseline 0.8% at 18:37.

devon (oncall): Verified internal e2e: passed. Confirming no prod customers on canary. Closing page? Any objections?

carla (product): No objections, please create incident doc and assign RCA owner.

jordan (sre): I can take infra/system portion. Assigning RCA ownership split:
- infra/runtime: jordan (sre)
- model build/CI: maria (ml-oncall) + sam (engineer)
- rollout pipeline: lee (infra)
- customer comms/impact: carla (product)

maria (ml-oncall): Initial action items for RCA:
- share model build logs (`ci-1234`), and quantization config
- confirm kernel support matrix for `qint4-blocked` vs `qint4-packed`
- add a gating test in CI to assert runtime compatibility before promoting image

sam (engineer): Saving logs and diffs to `s3://redwood-incident-logs/1968001234/` and adding to the post-incident doc.

devon (oncall): Closing notes: rollback completed, canary stable. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-1968001234 and will attach timeline + logs. If any of the owners want a hot follow-up meeting, ping me.

carla (product): Thanks team. Noting customer impact = none (internal-only). We'll schedule RCA write-up and include checklist: model pinning in rollout job, CI compatibility gate, observability alert tuning (distinguish internal canaries).

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-1968001234 created. Pager closed by devon at 18:42.

-- end of thread --
